schemes.name: Regalia Gold Plan
schemes.tagline: Pay for 11 months, we add the 12th — free.
schemes.description: Our flagship monthly gold savings scheme. Choose any fixed installment amount and pay it for 11 months. On the 12th month, Regal Jewellers contributes the installment for you. Redeem the full accumulated value — plus bonus — against jewellery purchases at any Regal Jewellers showroom.
highlights: 11 + 1 structure — one month's installment is on us
Redeemable at any branch across Kerala
No making-charge waiver cap — full value adjusted
Auto-debit / branch cash / UPI installment options

schemes.name: Akshyanidhi
schemes.description: A long-term wealth-building scheme for customers who want to plan bigger gold purchases. Choose a tenure of 12, 24 or 36 months — the longer you stay invested, the higher the maturity bonus on top of your paid-in installments.
highlights: Choice of 12 / 24 / 36-month tenure
Maturity bonus up to 11% of total installments
Redeemable for gold coins or jewellery
Transferable to family members on request

schemes.name: GoldGram
schemes.tagline: Buy gold in grams, any day, any amount.
schemes.description: Accumulate 24K digital gold in fractional grams at the live daily rate — no fixed schedule required. Top up whenever you like, track your grams in real time, and convert to physical gold or jewellery whenever you're ready.
highlights: Start from just ₹100
Buy at live daily rate, secured in your account
1-month minimum lock-in, then redeem anytime
Convert to coins, bars or jewellery

schemes.name: Swarnaraksha
schemes.tagline: Lock today's rate. Buy later, worry-free.
schemes.description: A gold-rate protection plan. Pay a small booking amount to lock in today's gold rate for a future purchase within the lock period — protecting you from price increases while you save the balance.
highlights: Lock in current rate with as little as 2% booking amount
Protection valid for up to 6 months
Balance payable anytime within the lock period
If the rate falls, you pay the lower rate instead

schemes.name: Swayamvara
schemes.description: Purpose-built for wedding jewellery savings. Larger installments and longer tenures suit big-ticket bridal purchases, with priority booking access and styling consultations as the wedding date approaches.
highlights: Higher installments for bigger wedding budgets
Tenure up to 60 months, bonus up to 15%
Priority slot booking during wedding season
Complimentary bridal styling consultation at maturity
